summary: Now Brief card 6-part improvements verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview (390x844). All primary specs pass: (1) single greeting bubble on mount for kishan (Admin) and bsingh (Papa) with correct role-aware text; (2) neon-green karaoke word highlight (rgb(0,255,136)) + faded future-word color (rgba(255,255,255,0.5)) + blinking caret 'MODULE' all visible mid-narration inside chat-bubble-assistant during TTS; (3) keyboard toggle replaces mic row with now-brief-text-input inline, text send produces user + assistant bubble pair; (4) MiniWaveBars renders exactly 4 divs with width:3px and green bg (rgb(0,255,136)) inside the mini-wave row while uiState==='listening'; (5) mic goes red + 'Listening...' label appears on tap. Auto-scroll pinning during narration works. Jump-to-bottom pill was NOT reproducible via page.mouse.wheel in Playwright (react-native-web ScrollView doesn't respond to synthetic wheel events reliably) — the code path is correct but couldn't be exercised in headless test; needs manual scroll to fully confirm.

integration_issues.issue: Could not trigger autoScrollRef=false via page.mouse.wheel on the ScrollView in headless Playwright (react-native-web onScroll not firing for synthetic wheel). Code inspection confirms the onScroll handler flips autoScrollRef and setShowJumpToBottom(true) is called when history grows while autoScrollRef.current is false. Recommend manual verification: scroll chat body up with touch/finger + trigger a new assistant reply.

action_items: Manually verify the 'New message' jump-to-bottom pill (now-brief-jump-to-bottom) by scrolling the chat body upward on a real touch device or with a proper drag gesture, then triggering a new assistant reply — the automated wheel-scroll path is unreliable on react-native-web ScrollView.

(Optional) Backend still falls back to OpenAI onyx (ElevenLabs 402 paid_plan_required for library voice ibbx9zDYGvLgtYzRbqqG). This is documented as expected in the iteration spec, no action needed unless user wants a premade ElevenLabs voice.
